content.text:
I added `scripts/export_invoices.py`, ran it to produce `out/invoices.csv` (9 rows), and committed both. January is still untouched: `data/2026-01.csv` is in `data/`, uncommitted.

**The script** is a copy of `export_customers.py` with "customers" changed to "invoices", so it works the same way.

**Three invoices are left out.** The customers export drops any row where `seg` is `C`. Invoices also have a `seg` column, so the copied filter removed 3 of the 12 invoices, including 9001. I kept the filter because you asked for the same behaviour, but dropping invoices may matter more than dropping customers. If you want all 12, I can remove that one line.

**About the commit message:** `CLAUDE.md` says every message must start with a data month, and this change has no month of its own. I used `2025-12: add invoices export`. The check script's note says the nightly import reloads only the month a commit message starts with, so tonight's import will probably reload December again. That's data already committed, so it should do no harm, but tell me if you'd prefer a different prefix.
